title: Biquad coefficient and parametric band unit tests
description:
Add juce::UnitTest coverage for coefficient design and parametric band behavior. Prefer registering sources in CMake only if b.4 already uses explicit lists—this task may append tests/BiquadTests.cpp and tests/ParametricBandTests.cpp to the ShredEQUnitTests target if required for linkage; if CMake edit is necessary, keep the change limited to those two test files in the unit-test target.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/BiquadCoefficients.*
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.*
- Source/DSP/TPTFilter.* (smoke if handy)
- tests/TestMain.cpp unit-test runner pattern
- CMakeLists.txt ShredEQUnitTests target_sources as left by b.4
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md § testing notes: static magnitude ±0.1 dB through operating range with documented Nyquist exceptions; multi-rate checks

Implement:
1. tests/BiquadTests.cpp — juce::UnitTest suite:
   - slope cascade section counts for 6/12/18/24/36/48 dB/oct
   - peak/bell designed at known f0/G/Q: magnitude near f0 within ±0.1 dB of requested gain at 48 kHz (away from Nyquist)
   - LP/HP sanity (attenuation above/below cutoff directionally correct)
   - evaluate near Nyquist at 48 kHz and 96 kHz and record/assert only what the digital design guarantees (no false analog-match claims)
2. tests/ParametricBandTests.cpp — juce::UnitTest suite:
   - 12-band container construct/prepare/reset
   - bypassed/disabled band is unity (impulse or DC/pink check within tight tolerance)
   - linked dual-mono process runs without allocating (can smoke process a small buffer)
   - routing mode left vs right does not apply filter energy to the opposite channel for a mono-impulse-on-one-channel case
   - assert absence of M/S matrix symbols/encoding by behavioral check (mid-only mode does not rotate L/R into synthetic stereo when fed mid-domain buffer treated as channel 0/1 per API docs)
3. CMakeLists.txt — only if unit-test target will not otherwise compile the new tests: append tests/BiquadTests.cpp and tests/ParametricBandTests.cpp to ShredEQUnitTests sources.

Do NOT rewrite DSP production logic except for minimal testability hooks if absolutely required and already permitted paths; prefer testing public APIs.
acceptance_criteria: tests/BiquadTests.cpp exists and registers juce::UnitTest coverage for RBJ designs and slope section counts
tests/ParametricBandTests.cpp exists and registers juce::UnitTest coverage for 12-band prepare/process/bypass and routing channel masking
BiquadTests include a ±0.1 dB (or documented tolerance) magnitude check at band center for a peaking filter away from Nyquist
CMakeLists.txt ShredEQUnitTests target includes tests/BiquadTests.cpp and tests/ParametricBandTests.cpp when source lists are explicit
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: broad CMake refactors beyond appending the two test sources to ShredEQUnitTests

allowed: juce::UnitTest subclasses in anonymous or free functions
append only the two new test cpp files to unit-test target_sources
document Nyquist exception tolerances in test expect messages
forbidden: reimplement coefficient math inside tests instead of calling production API
modify production DSP algos to force green tests without necessity
